description: Administrators only, and this one CHANGES things: set how large one uploaded file may be in a company, in whole megabytes from 1 to 1024 — above the platform's 100 MB, which the company's own administrators cannot; omit 'megabytes' for the platform's. A raised number holds at the doors that stream (an issue's and a wiki page's file, a document sent to a checklist item, a Jira import's files) where bytes go to an object store ('streams'); a chat's file, a secret file and MCP's base64 stay at 100 MB. A line in the company's journal and in the platform's ('file-limit'). Answers the limit as the company's screen reads it: 'megabytes', 'effectiveMegabytes', 'raised'.

megabytes.description: Whole megabytes, 1 to 1024; omit for the platform's own.

slug.description: The company's slug, as admin_workspaces lists it.

name: admin_set_workspace_file_limit
